segments.text: Leader of the Imperial Japanese Royal Guard and the de-facto head of government of the Empire of Japan.

cast.characterName: イーニァ・シェスチナ
cast.originalCharacterName: イーニァ・シェスチナ

segments.text: A Surface Pilot in the Idol Test Unit. She and her co-pilot Cryska are known and feared as the Scarlet Twins. Her innocent demeanor and young appearance belie her shocking aptitude as a pilot. She looks up to Cryska like an older sister, and is terribly afraid of being separated from her. Many of the things she says are mysterious, and for some reason, she takes a special interest in Yuuya.
From Official website

Formerly of the US Army Combat Technology Research Unit. At the top of his class in both practical combat skill and book learning. He is the main test pilot for the XFJ Joint US-Japan TSF Development Project, and serves as a member of the project’s Argus Test Flight. His father is Japanese and his mother is American. When he was young, political friction between Japan and America made him the subject of anti-Japanese discrimination. He grew up to hate America, and develop a cold attitude that keeps others at bay.
From Official website

A TSF pilot in the Japanese Royal Guard, which serves to protect the Shogun’s family. She is a member of the Takamura Clan, one of the high-ranking Fudai families, and constantly strives to live up to the family name, and to the reputation of her father, a legendary soldier. Because of this, she has a strict and uncompromising personality and is very hard on herself. She is sent to Yukon Base as the Japanese lead developer of the XFJ Project. As a Japanese, she finds Yuuya’s criticism of Japan frustrating, and makes no attempt to hide her irritation. The two of them clash constantly.
From Official website

cast.characterName: クリスカ・ビャーチェノワ
cast.originalCharacterName: クリスカ・ビャーチェノワ

segments.text: A TSF pilot in the Soviet Military’s Idol test unit. She pilots a multi-seater Su-37B, and her skills as a pilot far exceed anyone else’s. She and her fellow pilot, Inia, are known as the “Scarlet Twins”. She is fiercely loyal to her homeland, and cold to those around her, but her emotions towards Inia are somewhere between love and obsession.
From Official website

cast.characterName: ヴィンセント・ローウェル
cast.originalCharacterName: ヴィンセント・ローウェル

segments.text: A mechanic sent to Yukon Base alongside Yuuya. Despite his young age, he was chosen as the chief mechanic of the XFJ project. Highly trusted by his unit due to his wide range of knowledge and skill with a wrench. He’s a hedonist and skirt-chaser who gets along well with VG, but he takes his work extremely serious. He’s known Yuuya since their time in the US army together, and they’re both friends and partners.
From Official website

A member of Argus Test Flight. Stubborn, with a quick temper and a strong dislike of losing. Tarisa is a Gurkha, a tribe of brave mountain fighters. She particularly excels in high-speed hand-to-hand combat, and has developed her own unit style of high-speed tactics she calls the “Kukri Knife”.
From Official website

cast.characterName: イブラヒム・ドーゥル
cast.originalCharacterName: イブラヒム・ドーゥル

segments.text: Commander of Argus. He was squad leader before Yuuya arrived, and piloted a TSF, but he’s passed on that role to Yuuya. Now he serves as commander, providing a pillar of psychological support to Argus’s members. After losing many of his men on the battlefield, his priority is keeping them safe.
From Official website

An Argus test pilot with accurate judgement and precise sniper capabilities. She has a calm, collected personality, and serves as the brain of the unit. Her statuesque beauty may make her seem cold at first glance, but in fact, she’s warm and caring.
From Official website

cast.characterName: ヴァレリオ・ジアコーザ
cast.originalCharacterName: ヴァレリオ・ジアコーザ

segments.text: Valerio keeps spirits in Argus high with the chipper, upbeat personality typical of Italians. He has a habit of chasing after any girl he sees, but he’s also caring and works hard to reduce tensions within the unit. His nickname is VG. He learned to pilot at TSF on the European front, and became quite good at it. His ability to read a situation, and his skill as a TSF pilot, make him a valued member of the team.
From Official website

cast.originalCharacterName: クラウス・ハルトウィック

cast.characterName: フランク・ハイネマン
cast.originalCharacterName: フランク・ハイネマン

segments.text: One of XFJ Project’s dedicated operators. The last of the three operators to join, and a new recruit. Inexperienced in many ways, but has an unflinching personality and a strong desire to learn.
From Official website

cast.characterName: ニイラム・ラワヌナンド
cast.originalCharacterName: ニイラム・ラワヌナンド

segments.text: One of XFJ Project’s dedicated operators. The highest-ranking of the three operators, she keeps the team working together smoothly. She may look like she has her act together on the surface, but actually has an oddball streak and a habit of getting lost in her own delusions.
From Official website

cast.characterName: フェーベ・テオドラキス
cast.originalCharacterName: フェーベ・テオドラキス

segments.text: One of XFJ Project’s dedicated operators. The youngest of the operators, but she has actual combat experience. She tries to act like an adult, but sometimes she fails. Interested in Japan, and always looking for a chance to talk to Yui.
From Official website

cast.characterName: イェジー・サンダーク
cast.originalCharacterName: イェジー・サンダーク

segments.text: Idol’s commanding officer and the man in charge of the ПЗ plan, the Soviet Union’s strategy against the BETA. Has an iron will and cold personality, and is constantly scheming. He is the one who suggested proving tests in actual combat against the BETA on the Kamchatka Peninsula, and he is also in charge of arranging matters on the ground. Sandek himself is a surface pilot, and a good one.
From Official website

cast.characterName: ナスターシャ・イヴァノワ
cast.originalCharacterName: ナスターシャ・イヴァノワ

segments.text: A surface pilot in the Zhar Battalion. She serves as Latrova’s XO and as a squadron commander, despite being only in her late teens. Good at her job, but when she gets excited her youthfulness shows itself. Respects her superior officer, Latrova, like a mother.
From Official website

cast.characterName: フィカーツィア・ラトロワ
cast.originalCharacterName: フィカーツィア・ラトロワ

segments.text: Commander of the Zhar Battalion, one of the Soviet’s top units. A pure-blooded Russian who leads a battalion of child soldiers from regions conquered by the Soviets, she is a veteran of many battles. A stern, military woman, but her unit looks up to her like a mother.
From Official website

segments.text: Leader of the Third Unified Front’s Bao Feng test flight. Loves to win more than anything, and strongly sees Idol and Argus as rivals. Her TSF fighting style is aggressive, to match her personality, and she specializes in close-range sword combat. Her men call her Big Sis as a show of respect.
From Official website

A surface pilot who’s part of the 65th Combat Training Battalion “Infinities”. Cheerful and caring, but sometimes acts stronger than she really is. She has a strong sense of intuition that she puts to good use both in and outside combat. She was once part of Yuuya and Leon’s team.
From Official website

A surface pilot who was in Yuuya’s unit in their US army days. Yuuya’s kill score left his in the dust. Presently part of the 65th Combat Training Battalion “Infinities”. He’s proud to be a Japanese-American, which meant he's constantly at odds with Yuuya. The two of them used to fight constantly.
From Official website
